checks: Completed held-out tests and unique seeds
Equal evaluation configuration and per-model training budget across seeds
External world and teacher fingerprints match across model kinds
Baseline/noise/reset midpoint request identities match within each model
Stored rates agree with counts; interventions occur exactly once
Training trajectory hashes match across models when present
limits: Hash/count audits do not reconstruct action traces.
Midpoint target populations can differ across models; pairing is within each model.
Parameter count, trainable parameters and runtime differ; FLOPs are not matched.

definitions.mean: Arithmetic mean of seed-level rates; each independent training seed has equal weight.
definitions.sample_sd: Sample standard deviation across seeds (n-1 denominator); null for fewer than two observations.
definitions.missing: A seed with no midpoint pending targets or no FINISH labels has a null corresponding rate and is excluded from that rate's mean.
definitions.targeted_pooled_rate: Sum of exact midpoint-request completions divided by sum of midpoint pending requests; distinct from the unweighted seed mean.
definitions.clean_completion: Eligible request completes without a rejected non-WAIT attempt while it was active.
definitions.finish_precision: Accepted FINISH actions / all FINISH attempts; zero if there are no attempts.
definitions.targeted_pairing: Eligible started unfinished requests with no same-job command at the midpoint; request IDs/masks match for baseline/noise/reset within each model and seed.
definitions.finish_agreement: Action agreement with evaluator labels. Closed-loop labels reflect the policy's own world trajectory; teacher-forced labels reflect the oracle trajectory.
definitions.clock_0375: Held-out observation-interval distribution, with separate exogenous stream seed; exact interval is recorded in input config.unseen_dt.
definitions.clock_half_double: Clock-calibration ablations: only the model's dt is scaled; world time, inputs and action opportunities are held fixed.
definitions.solver_half: Numerical control with max solver step halved and identical inputs/action opportunities; GRU has no autonomous solver.
definitions.runtime: Stored wall-clock measurements, including their original evaluator/training overhead; parameter counts and FLOPs are not matched.

checkpoint_verification.method: Regenerate schedules and rerun saved baseline policies in the frozen simulator; compare full prediction hash, world metrics and midpoint target identity.
checkpoint_verification.limit: This replay reuses the original simulator; it is not an independent simulator implementation.

posthoc_content_probe.method: Reuse the saved checkpoint and exact existing test teacher trajectory. At target>=3 only, score 11-way top-1, argmax(logits[...,3:])+3 over the eight FINISH content/version classes, and the actual top-1 WAIT/BEGIN/FINISH fractions.
posthoc_content_probe.interpretation: This probes recoverable content/version information in the existing readout at teacher-chosen FINISH moments. It is a teacher-forced diagnostic; it does not establish closed-loop timing competence or isolate every cause of failure.
